definitions.name: expression
definitions.description: Boolean applicability expression. A condition names one catalog condition; all_of/any_of preserve source Boolean structure; not preserves negation.

definitions.name: typed_comparison_datatype_consistency
definitions.description: A redundant explicit datatype, when supplied with a self-describing comparison, must agree with its comparison domain. Omitted datatype remains valid for typed scalar literals.

definitions.name: cardinality
definitions.description: Consistent 0.4 authoring cardinality vocabulary. 'every' means all relevant results satisfy the specified comparison; source OVAL lexical values belong in provenance only.

definitions.name: existence_cardinality
definitions.description: State field/record existence cardinality. Preserve the OVAL entity/record all_exist distinction pending separate evidence review.

definitions.name: item_existence_cardinality
definitions.description: Collected NG Items have no synthetic does-not-exist entries. OVAL Test all_exist and at_least_one_exists both map to one_or_more; preserve their original source attributes in provenance.

definitions.name: paired_requirement
definitions.description: Explicit field existence and matching cardinalities inherited together. Comparator-free absence is authored only on the individual field as values_found: none.

definitions.name: state_entry
definitions.title: Expected evidence condition
definitions.description: A field predicate or logical combination of predicates applied to one collected Item.

definitions.name: test
definitions.title: Automated Test
definitions.description: Use a Test Object or reference and a structured require; no separate State layer.

definitions.name: object_selector_predicate
definitions.description: Object selector: one explicit comparison operator key plus typed operand, independent value_match when operand has multiple values; never an observed-Item/State require and never Organizational Input.

definitions.name: object_record_field_predicate
definitions.description: WMI/cmdlet native collector record field. One explicit comparator plus required selection_match; no existence/require hidden default.

definitions.name: item_presence_requirement
definitions.title: Item existence requirement
definitions.description: Checks population existence without comparing State predicates; corresponds to State-free OVAL check_existence.

definitions.name: scoped_state_entry
definitions.title: Expected evidence condition
definitions.description: A field predicate or logical combination of predicates applied to one collected Item.

definitions.name: absence_only_field_predicate
definitions.description: The only comparator-free field condition is confirmed absence, not an empty value or failed collection.

definitions.name: canonical_inherited_record_predicate
definitions.description: Record correlation and aggregation retained; member comparisons inherit the nearest complete Test/group/record field policy. Local overrides must be complete pairs.

definitions.name: canonical_all_items_requirement
definitions.title: Condition logic
definitions.description: One complete Test requirement: item_requirement gives explicit existence and satisfaction counts; conditions follow as fields/and/or/one/xor. Field cardinality must be explicit.

definitions.name: value_comparison
definitions.description: One typed comparison against an author-declared scalar literal. Variable and Input references are intentionally excluded from a constraint leaf.

definitions.name: value_constraint_expression
definitions.description: Generic typed value constraint expression. A comparison leaf uses the existing native comparison operators; Boolean nodes combine leaf outcomes. This grammar is used for bounded Input constraints and is not OVAL-specific.

definitions.name: group
definitions.description: Nested XCCDF Group projection. Group-local applicability is independent and combines with every ancestor restriction.

definitions.name: object_entity_base
definitions.description: Version-local 0.4 Object selector, no 0.3 value+operation longhand.

definitions.name: state_filter
definitions.title: Filter action
definitions.description: One field-key predicate with an explicit include/exclude Set filter action.

definitions.name: test_reference_set
definitions.description: Test-local comparison expressions; no State IDs or redundant capability declarations.

definitions.name: file_traversal
definitions.description: Independent/Unix file traversal. Preserves the complete non-deprecated OVAL recurse vocabulary.

definitions.name: set_expression
definitions.description: Set composition compatible with OVAL 5.12.3 set semantics. A single operand is valid for union, intersection, or difference and evaluates to that operand after its filters are applied; difference is limited to at most two operands.

definitions.name: file_traversal_base
definitions.description: Shared non-deprecated downward file recursion structure. Traversal direction is fixed by this construct as downward; deprecated OVAL recurse_direction=up is not representable.

definitions.name: windows_file_traversal
definitions.description: Windows file traversal. Preserves the non-deprecated OVAL junction terminology rather than silently treating it as Unix symlink syntax.

definitions.name: object_record_field
definitions.description: Collector Object record field. Required selection_match is independent from expected-value value_match and Test/State require; legacy match/value/operation not accepted.

definitions.name: object_record
definitions.description: Authored WMI/cmdlet collector input record. Named fields use one comparator-as-key and explicit selection_match, not the old match/value/operation syntax. Record names are structurally unique.

definitions.name: filesystem_scope
definitions.title: Filesystem
definitions.description: For newly authored NG file Objects, editors suggest local and serialize it explicitly (optionally hidden in the editor). This annotation is not a scanner/runtime default. Source conversion must retain the effective OVAL recurse_file_system value: omitted OVAL means all, explicitly local means local, and defined maps to same. Filesystem scope is independent of recursion and applies to full_path as well as directory/name selection.

definitions.name: foreach_binding
definitions.description: Native 0.4 collection-expansion foreach binding. The source is one named shared/referenceable Object. Chaining is permitted: a source Object may itself use for_each, creating correlated lexical lineage. Independent multi-source Cartesian expansion is not implicit.

definitions.name: foreach_selector_binding
definitions.description: Bind this selector from one field of a visible foreach lineage alias, e.g. user.home_dir. In a chained foreach, aliases inherited from the source Object remain correlated and visible.

definitions.name: inline_object
definitions.title: Inline collection Object
definitions.description: Inline native Object. Capability-specific resource selectors and acquisition parameters are direct Object fields; generic select/collect wrappers are not part of the 0.4.1 grammar. The capability-specific generated schema validates each direct field, including native windows.cmdlet select. Filters and Set operations retain their own semantic boundaries.

definitions.name: object_use
definitions.title: Object declaration or reference
definitions.description: Use an inline Object or an existing shared Object.

definitions.name: literal_collection
definitions.description: Non-empty ordered literal collection. Duplicates are preserved; datatype validity and source-equivalent matching quantifier are validated separately.

definitions.name: authoring_type_resolution
definitions.description: Native 0.4 authoring permits omission of datatype only when a literal and operation unambiguously establish comparison type. Direct Variable/Input/list comparisons retain datatype; compiler expands this union to the exact typed canonical OVAL predicate before capability checks and bundle emission. Typed operation plus datatype is prohibited.

definitions.name: expression
definitions.title: Assessment logic
definitions.description: Explicit new-authoring selection for assessment logic; applies only in explicit logical group. Preserve source-effective values and visible overrides; no runtime fallback.

definitions.name: linux_dpkginfo_name_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 dpkginfo_object.name is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; Debian package version/EVR state comparison remains separate from package-name selection.

definitions.name: linux_partition_mount_point_selector
definitions.description: The native contract uses the string selector vocabulary. Source-specific conversion must retain the selected operation and does not infer a broader typed comparison.

definitions.name: linux_selinuxboolean_name_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 selinuxboolean_object.name is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; current and pending Boolean state values are not selector aliases.

definitions.name: linux_systemdunitdependency_unit_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 systemdunitdependency_object.unit is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; dependency state is not an additional selector.

definitions.name: linux_systemdunitproperty_unit_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 systemdunitproperty_object.unit and property are EntityObjectStringType selectors. Preserve all five source string operations; the collected property value remains a state field.

definitions.name: linux_systemdunitproperty_property_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 systemdunitproperty_object.unit and property are EntityObjectStringType selectors. Preserve all five source string operations; the collected property value remains a state field.

definitions.name: unix_file_filepath_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 unix file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Existing traversal constraints stay in the capability mapping.

definitions.name: unix_file_path_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 unix file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Existing traversal constraints stay in the capability mapping.

definitions.name: unix_file_filename_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 unix file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Existing traversal constraints stay in the capability mapping.

definitions.name: unix_interface_name_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 interface_object.name is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; interface type/address state fields are not selector aliases.

definitions.name: unix_password_username_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 password_object.username is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations and the authored spelling; account lookup and collected-field comparison remain separate.

definitions.name: unix_shadow_username_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 shadow_object.username is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations and the authored spelling; account lookup and collected-field comparison remain separate.

definitions.name: windows_file_filepath_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 Windows file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Filesystem lookup remains per-directory/provider case context from the existing mapping; no global case switch is added.

definitions.name: windows_file_path_selector
definitions.description: OVAL 5.12.3 Windows file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Filesystem lookup remains per-directory/provider case context from the existing mapping; no global case switch is added.

definitions.name: typed_value

definitions.name: declaration
definitions.description: Declare a native Variable with kind and expression. Result datatypes are inferred from typed literal values, canonical collected fields, referenced Variables, and defined operations. No declaration datatype is accepted; implicit lexical casts are forbidden.

coverage_policy.status_semantics: Expected statuses are typed oracle values, not Booleanized PASS/FAIL. Negation is only the canonical not expression.
